newsitem.title: UK: British Gas announces 841 mln Q4 charges.
newsitem.headline: British Gas announces 841 mln Q4 charges.

text.p: British Gas Plc on Friday announced that its fourth quarter results will include exceptional charges totalling 841 million stg.

The total amount breaks down in 341 million stg for take-or-pay gas contract renegotiations with British Petroleum and Mobil and 500 million for restructuring provisions, write down of suprlus property and demerger costs.
Of the 500 million stg charge, 93 million stg relates to Centrica, the trading which will be demerged in February.
The 93 million stg has been charged to the new company's proforma accounts for the nine months to September 30, 1996 -- its last before it floats.
After taking into account this charge, Centrica made a proforma loss before tax of 452 million pounds in the period, the company said.
